description: Swift is a language used for Apple apps and other programs. It has clear tools for values that may be missing. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install Swift or use Xcode on a Mac. Save each example as lesson.swift and run swift lesson.swift.
whatYouWillLearn: Put a value in text with Swift
Walk through a range with Swift
Read only when present with Swift
